# Image Assets

Place all image files in their respective subfolders.

## Structure

| Folder | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `teaser/` | Teaser gallery preview images |
| `gallery/` | Full photo gallery images |
| `final/` | Final reveal / celebration images |
| `backgrounds/` | Scene background images |
| `decorations/` | Decorative elements (flowers, ribbons, etc.) |
| `icons/` | Custom icons and logos |
| `placeholders/` | Fallback placeholder images |

## Usage

All image paths are managed centrally in `src/config/images.ts`.
To replace an image, simply upload a new file with the same name to the matching folder.
No code changes are required.

## Naming Convention

Use lowercase kebab-case: `memory-1.jpg`, `gallery-birthday-cake.png`
